plan.scope: All19 unchanged official chart PDFs, all26 activation slots each. Observe visible grayscale triangle orientation independently of FateBridge. Blank slots are no_visible_marker, never automatically unfixed. No birth inputs or PDF facts may be replaced after comparison.
plan.orientation: Compare component centroid y with its bounding-box midpoint; positive offset means upward triangle (exaltation). Negative offset means downward triangle (detriment). Reject symmetric or out-of-row candidates.

source.collection: Normal interactive public page; fictitious inputs, optional email omitted. Direct validity API returned 401 and was not used for calculation. Rendered SVG numeric labels and properties copied independently of FateBridge results; every PDF downloaded through the page.

cohort_sources.selection_scope: Eight fixed winter inputs, one city, three core Types and Generator subtypes, three authorities, three profiles, one Cross and eight distinct Variable codes. source.collection: Normal interactive public page, 11 fictitious frozen inputs; optional email omitted; no account or direct calculation API. transcription_crosscheck.scope: Non-cryptographic transcription crosscheck only: normalized page facts equal the separate local SVG/PDF transcription. PDF SHA-256 binds source artifacts; the frozen plan never supplies expected values.

source.property_whitespace: Whitespace normalized between rendered page and PDF; case/spelling unchanged. Upheaval has two spaces before the parenthesis on the page and one in the PDF.

cohort_sources.selection_scope: Finite conformance to 11 engine-selected branch-coverage examples; inputs frozen before official outputs. Engine-selected stratification is not a blind or population benchmark. All observations retained, including failures. Official displayed gate.lines and structure do not independently establish Color, Tone, Base, astronomical precision, every original rule or real-world predictive validity.

scope: All 19 original PDFs and 494 activation slots, no selection after comparison. Gate.lines are the unchanged printed cohort observations. Raster triangle polarity is observed independently of FateBridge. Not an independent birth-clock or astronomy reference.
rendering_limit: Public widget references a combined fixing symbol but its fixing asset object only defines exalted and detriment. No visible marker does not identify unfixed versus juxtaposition or other hidden states. The 356 blank slots cannot certify full fixing states.
